contract.model: Naturally straight isotropic bending only; E=0.5*k*|kb|^2, k=2B/(Lprev+Lnext); root k=2B/Lfirst. All three kb components have alpha=1/k.
contract.curvature: kb=2*(a cross b)/D, D=|a||b|+a dot b. Its norm is2*tan(theta/2), not theta.
contract.derivative: da=|b|*a/|a|+b; db=|a|*b/|b|+a; Ja=(-2*skew(b)-kb*da^T)/D; Jb=(2*skew(a)-kb*db^T)/D; point Jacobians=(-Ja,Ja-Jb,Jb). Root point Jacobians=(-Jb,Jb).
contract.differentiation: Full current-length derivatives included. Inextensible-manifold formulas alone need not match unrestricted positional finite differences.
contract.order: B0x,B0y,B0z,S0,B1x,B1y,B1z,S1,... scalar half-bandwidth10; four-row block half-bandwidth2.
contract.symmetry: Rotate vector multipliers with the geometry; stretch multipliers are scalars. Isotropic three-row compliance is rotation invariant.
contract.scope: No torsional energy, material directors, anisotropic/rest-curved rods, contact or guaranteed behavior near antiparallel degeneracy.

expected.reason: kb has infinite magnitude at pi; do not silently skip and label converged.
